Weekly details Fellow, procedure type, counts and timing statistics

Weeks are consecutive seven-day periods beginning July 1 (week 1 = July 1–7), not ISO calendar weeks. No weeks after the latest exam are shown. Provider, procedure, cohort and fellowship-year filters apply throughout. Historical comparison-window filters do not apply here.

How cases are counted · data coverage

Unique cases count each procedure once across selected providers. Provider procedure counts sum each provider’s distinct cases: one shared case can contribute to more than one provider. Repeated codes, provider IDs and roles do not add extra counts for the same named provider.

Where an EXAMID is available, it identifies the case. Otherwise, MRN + exact exam timestamp + procedure type identifies a case. Provider names are uppercased and extra spaces removed; different spellings are not automatically merged.

Fellowship starts are inferred for the 31 apparent cohort members in the initial export. Review them with Fellowship settings. Other names are unassigned. Activity outside the first three inferred years appears under “Other / unassigned.” Missing historical cohorts are shown as unavailable, not zero.

“Matched year to date” uses the export’s latest exam month, day and time as the same cutoff in every academic year. “Completed academic years” excludes the academic year containing the latest exam. An increase in volume can reflect more providers being represented, not just increased activity.

CSV imports run locally in your browser and replace the current dataset. Imports replace the data for this browser session; reopening the original file restores its embedded data. The embedded dataset contains anonymous case numbers, timestamps, provider names, procedure types and duration measurements; it does not retain MRNs, codes or other patient identifiers. No external scripts or network services are used.

Cumulative views count distinct cases or provider–case pairs through each selected period. Within-year totals reset on July 1. The Jul–Jun comparison draws one series for each academic year. Future months are unavailable rather than zero.

Timing statistics count each case once per group. Insertion and withdrawal default to colonoscopies. Blank, unparseable, nonpositive or conflicting measurements are excluded; the table shows valid and excluded counts. Positive outliers remain unless you apply a duration limit. All time statistics are in minutes.
